title: 第二十三章 改造血手印的念头第二十四章 文字符箓能量的衍化
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
感受着梦境世界之中，那不断流转，并行不悖的梦境世界力量，以及恐惧之力，血手印的力量，陆羽陷入了沉思之中。
看来，他确实是需要进行能量的统合定义，再一次的突破了。
否则的话，随着他能力的增多，拥有的种种力量，必然会变得五花八门，驳杂混乱，挤占梦境世界的空间。
并且，因为众多能力能量，虽然在梦境世界之中，可以进行彼此的转化。
但却极为的困难缓慢，临到战斗之时，谁又会给他准备、转化能量的时间？
不过，那却也是并不急于一时的，摸了摸咕咕叫的肚子，还是要先填饱肚子再说。
而在陆羽准备填饱肚子的时候，县中心医院的一间病房，满脸苍白的张威，在经过充足的休息之后，终于是缓缓睁开了双眼。
看着白色的天花板，张威微微茫然了片刻...
他还活着了吗？
渐渐的，张威想起了昨天夜里发生的事情。
不由的，他的脸色再次一变，转头打量周围。
一间独立病房，田果馨正趴在他的一旁睡觉，眉头还不时的皱起，似乎在做着什么噩梦。
而陈杰则是坐在远处的椅子上，正仰着头睡得香甜，似乎并没有受到什么影响。
“呼~！”
见此一幕，张威不由微微松了口气，看来那一个人，是真的对他们没有什么恶意。
不过，河县突然出现了这样一位存在，他还是要将情况，尽快上报上去的。
想到这里，张威便是看了看身上，依旧还是他原来的衣服，他不由便是伸出手来，想要掏出特制的手机。
或许是张威的动作，惊动了一旁的田果馨。
田果馨一个机灵起身，见到苏醒的张威，立即便是惊喜的喊道：
“队长！

你醒了！
你有没有感觉哪里不舒服...”
“队、队长，队长咋啦？”
而另一边的陈杰，在听到田果馨的呼喊之后，也是猛然间惊醒，差点没有直接滑下椅子，跌倒在地上。
一阵手忙脚乱之后，这才是重新站稳，看向了病床的所在。
当他看清眼前情况之后，这才是微微松了口气。
“队长，你醒了！”
“嗯，你们没事吧？”
看着陈杰和田果馨，张威微微笑了笑。
“我们没事！”
陈杰、田果馨两人齐齐摇头。
“嗯，没事就好，没事就好。
我记得我当初晕倒了，之后发生了什么？”
“哦，是这样的...”
在听到张威的询问之后，陈杰两人立即便将昨天的事情，一五一十的说了一遍。
“哦，是这样吗？”
张威若有所思的点点头。
随后，张威便是掏出了自己的特制手机，拨通了一个号码。
“领导...”
当张威将这里的情况汇报一遍之后，电话对面久久没有回话。

而张威也只能忐忑的等着。
过了好半晌，电话那头才终于是传出了一道声音。
content_en:
Feeling the power of the dream world that was constantly flowing and running in parallel in the dream world, as well as the power of fear and the power of the blood handprint, Lu Yu fell into deep thought.
It seems that he really needs to integrate the definition of energy and make another breakthrough.
Otherwise, as his abilities increase, the various powers he possesses will inevitably become diverse, confusing, and occupy the space of the dream world.
Moreover, because of the many abilities and energies, they can be transformed into each other even in the dream world.
But it is extremely difficult and slow. When the battle comes, who will give him time to prepare and transform energy?
However, it was not in a hurry. I touched my growling stomach and wanted to fill it up first.
While Lu Yu was preparing to fill his stomach, in a ward of the County Central Hospital, the pale Zhang Wei finally slowly opened his eyes after adequate rest.
Looking at the white ceiling, Zhang Wei was slightly confused for a moment...
Is he still alive?
Gradually, Zhang Wei remembered what happened last night.
Involuntarily, his expression changed again, and he turned to look around.
In an independent ward, Tian Guoxin was sleeping next to him, her brows furrowing from time to time, as if she was having a nightmare.
Chen Jie, on the other hand, was sitting on a chair far away, sleeping soundly with his head raised, seemingly unaffected.
"Huh~!"
Seeing this scene, Zhang Wei couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief. It seemed that that person really had no ill intentions towards them.
However, such a person suddenly appeared in He County, and he still wanted to report the situation as soon as possible.
Thinking of this, Zhang Wei looked at his body and saw that he was still wearing his original clothes. He couldn't help but stretched out his hand to take out the specially made mobile phone.
Perhaps it was Zhang Wei's actions that alerted Tian Guoxin who was standing aside.
Tian Guoxin stood up smartly and when she saw Zhang Wei was awake, she immediately shouted in surprise:
"Captain!
You're awake!
Do you feel uncomfortable somewhere..."
"Team, captain, what's wrong, captain?"
On the other side, Chen Jie woke up suddenly after hearing Tian Guoxin's shout. He almost slid off the chair and fell to the ground.
After a while of fussing, he regained his balance and looked at the hospital bed.
When he saw the situation clearly, he breathed a sigh of relief.
"Captain, you wake up!"
"Well, are you okay?"
Looking at Chen Jie and Tian Guoxin, Zhang Wei smiled slightly.
"We're fine!"
Chen Jie and Tian Guoxin both shook their heads.
“Well, it’s okay as long as it’s okay, it’s okay as long as it’s okay.
I remember I fainted. What happened after that? "
"Oh, that's it..."
After hearing Zhang Wei's inquiry, Chen Jie and Chen Jie immediately recounted what happened yesterday in detail.
"Oh, is that so?"
Zhang Wei nodded thoughtfully.
Then, Zhang Wei took out his special mobile phone and dialed a number.
"Leadership..."
After Zhang Wei reported the situation here, there was no reply from the other party on the phone for a long time.
And Zhang Wei could only wait anxiously.
After a long while, a voice finally came from the other end of the phone.
